scenes.narration: Jacob loved his son Joseph more than all his other children, and made him a coat of many colours.

scenes.narration: When his brothers saw it, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.

scenes.narration: Then Joseph dreamed a dream: their sheaves of wheat bowed down to his.

scenes.narration: So they took him, and cast him into a pit. And the pit was empty; there was no water in it.
